slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time the total regular (non-overtime) capacity available across both shifts, or is it the total capacity including any overtime hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent clarified the role/meaning of the 110 hours, but never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a prioritized soft goal, nor its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on the total number of overtime hours that can be worked per week, or is overtime unlimited as long as it is minimized?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime cap exists, touching the constraint nature, but never asked whether the 10-hour rule is a strict bound vs. a prioritized soft goal, nor its position in the objective hierarchy.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 hours is a regular (non-overtime) capacity that is a hard bound, treated as such in the model constraint (x_c + x_l)/1000 <= 110 + O.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only what the 110 hours represents, never confirming whether the full-utilization requirement is a hard constraint or a prioritized soft goal, yet enforced it as a rigid capacity limit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a hard constraint (O <= 10).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether a maximum overtime limit exists; it never confirmed whether that limit is a strict upper bound or a soft goal with a priority, yet coded it as a rigid constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the two P0 goal-structure slots (110-hour utilization goal and 10-hour overtime goal vs. hard constraint and their priorities) remained only partially addressed, and it silently enforced both as hard constraints.

summary: The agent gathered useful numeric and scope clarifications but never probed the preemptive goal-programming structure, treating both the 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime cap as hard constraints; this leaves two P0 slots unresolved and produces a prematurely stopped interaction.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
